name: wild man of the wood
text: wild man of the wood is a MacKillop cross-reference to the canonical wild man in Celtic legend entry. MacKillop records the form as one name for the hairy, often naked wild figure of British medieval tradition. The principal record of the Celtic wild-man tradition sits under wild man in Celtic legend.
